patch.title: Get the Founding Member campaign scheduled and started: first launch email and member re-engagement on November 17
patch.detail: Preparation checklist for LIVE-BETA-LAUNCH-CAMPAIGN. The original 2026-11-10 target (ready and started on the 11th) passed with nothing sent; as of 2026-11-16 the first launch email and the member re-engagement are due November 17 at 10am Pacific. Drafts live in /mnt/project-files/campaign/ (FOUNDING-MEMBER-DRAFTS.md, AUDIENCE-FUNNELS-DRAFTS.md); 10 unsent Email Studio drafts and 2 draft Funnels (casual-browsers, web-followers) sit under danieltyack in Frequency Community. TO DO: (1) Daniel reviews the 10 drafts and 2 funnels and approves or edits copy. (2) Daniel approves audience lists: launch emails go to opted-in members (almost all free, only a couple paid); the pricing email leaves out current payers; casual browsers need on-site consent; people Daniel meets get a personal note first and marketing only after a yes. (3) Schedule launch emails: Nov 17, Dec 8, Dec 22 and Jan 1 at 10am Pacific; member re-engagement starts Nov 17 and skips anyone who got a launch email in the past 7 days. (4) Publish the two Funnels after review. (5) Date conflict: RESOLVED. Dates come from lib/core/launch-dates.ts: launch January 1, 2027, Public Beta through January 31, 2027; December 31 is the end of Hosts Beta intake only. (6) Confirm the stay-in-the-loop capture carries a consent line and no persona or wellness data reaches pixels or click parameters. The shipped come-back emails (lib/launch/comeback-email.ts) are unchanged. Nothing is sent until Daniel approves recipients, content and schedule.
